name: commit-trace-bundle
description: Files mirrored into the target repo and the host-only inputs the host checker needs, each with host path, target path and digest. Deterministic. The host commit pin lives in host-pin.json under a two-stage A/S seal.

sealProtocol.stageA: authority commit A fixes the FINAL bytes of the generator, the mirrored artifacts and the host-only inputs; its host-pin.json still carries the all-zero placeholder, so --check is EXPECTED to fail at A
sealProtocol.stageS: seal commit S changes ONLY host-pin.json (hostCommit=A, bundleDigest) and touches no other blob
sealProtocol.stageP: packet commit P is a child of S that changes only the SDT-G30 packet/body pair and echoes A, S and bundleDigest into AC9; --check is a FULL CLOSURE gate and passes only at P and at PR head
sealProtocol.authority: blob authority = A, pin authority = S, packet/closure authority = P; any later artifact change requires a NEW A/S/P triple
sealProtocol.candidate: the C/R candidate records A, S, P and bundleDigest

targetCheckerContract: verify every mirroredFiles digest against the checked-out target copy at targetPath
recompute bundleDigest from the hostPath+digest sequence and compare
verify host-pin.json bundleDigest equals this bundleDigest and hostCommit equals the A recorded in the candidate evidence
validate manifest structure (universes, disjointness, conditional schema, attributeMatrix, exact sets)
NEVER regenerate expected bytes from the target copy: a target-side --write is forbidden
